articles.summary: Howdy all, We’ve rolled out Virtualmin Podman 2.2.0 to all Virtualmin repos. articles.summary: Howdy, After a good deal of work and testing, I’m happy to announce a new Virtualmin GoAccess module. It is a modern replacement for the AWStats and Webalizer reports, with an interactive, good-looking dashboard that follows your Virtualmin theme in both light and dark modes.
